items.headline: U.S. Stocks Exhibit Mixed Performance Amid Economic Data and Geopolitical Concerns
items.summary: U.S. stocks saw mixed movements today as investors balanced cooling Federal Reserve rate-hike expectations with disappointing July retail sales figures and ongoing Middle East tensions. Major indices hovered near recent highs, with technology showing relative strength in pre-market trading, while a busy week of retail earnings reports looms large.

items.headline: S&P 500
items.statContext: Slipped as of 9:35 a.m. Eastern time

items.headline: Dow Jones Industrial Average
items.statContext: Down 174 points as of 9:35 a.m. Eastern time

items.headline: Cerebras Systems Surges on OpenAI Deal
items.summary: Shares of $CBRS climbed 15% after the company announced its chips would power OpenAI's new Ultrafast tier for GPT-5.6 Sol, highlighting a progression in their existing relationship.

items.headline: SanDisk Extends Rally
items.summary: $SNDK advanced 8% in early trading, continuing momentum from its upbeat investor day on August 13.

items.headline: Western Digital Rallies with Memory Sector
items.summary: Western Digital ($WDC) saw a 6.5% gain as the broader memory-storage sector rallied following SanDisk's positive investor day presentation.

items.headline: Snap Inc. Declines in Premarket
items.summary: Snap Inc. ($SNAP) dropped 12.20% in premarket trading.

items.headline: Constellation Brands Falls Post-Earnings
items.summary: Beer, wine, and spirits company Constellation Brands ($STZ) declined 4.8% following its recent earnings report and multiple analyst price-target reductions.

items.headline: Molson Coors Under Continued Pressure
items.summary: Molson Coors Beverage ($TAP) fell 4.2% as pressure continued following its second-quarter 2026 earnings report.

items.headline: July Retail Sales Disappoint, Consumer Sentiment Falls
items.summary: U.S. retail sales for July fell by 0.6%, marking the first decline in nine months and missing consensus expectations. This, coupled with a drop in preliminary consumer sentiment from 55.2 to 51.0 in August, suggests a loss of consumer momentum.

items.headline: FOMC Minutes Anticipated This Wednesday
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Open Market Committee's (FOMC) July 28–29 meeting are scheduled for release on Wednesday. Investors will scrutinize the text for insights into the Fed's views on inflation and the economic outlook, especially following recent soft inflation data and a decline in retail sales.

items.headline: Major Retailers to Report Earnings This Week
items.summary: Wall Street is bracing for a wave of earnings reports from major retailers, including Home Depot ($HD), Target ($TGT), Lowe's ($LOW), and Walmart ($WMT). These reports will offer crucial insights into consumer health amidst elevated inflation and a weakening labor market.

items.headline: AI and Energy Sectors Show Strength, Retail and Airlines Lag
items.summary: The AI infrastructure and energy sectors continue to demonstrate strong performance, driven by significant investments and geopolitical factors. In contrast, airlines, retailers, and homebuilders lagged in recent sessions, reflecting shifting market dynamics and consumer behavior.
